vulnerability_type: Denial of Service via Transaction Rate Limiting

preconditions.description: Contract state must be set to Restricted mode via setBotProtection(true)
Attacker must hold BNRG tokens to initiate transactions
Owner must have enabled Restricted mode (or attacker controls owner)

exploit_hint: 1. Ensure contract is in Restricted state (owner calls setBotProtection(true)). 2. Attacker initiates transfer() transactions to target victim addresses with amounts <= maxRestrictionAmount. 3. Each transaction updates lastTx[sender] and lastTx[recipient] to block.timestamp. 4. For 60 seconds after, victim addresses cannot send or receive tokens as the launchRestrict modifier will revert with 'only one tx/min in restricted mode'. 5. Repeat to maintain DoS on target addresses continuously.
